evidence_item.bbox: finite [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized page coordinates; 0<=x0<=x1<=1 and 0<=y0<=y1<=1
evidence_item.raw_text: optional exact extractor output; never silently normalized

invariants: Every item binds to the exact original source_sha256.
No item without page_index and bbox may be used as geometric evidence.
Adapter output may annotate but must never create, merge, or split electrical nets.
Missing/invalid provenance yields UNKNOWN and a nonzero required-validation result.
Conflicting text and vector evidence yields CONFLICT or UNKNOWN, never VERIFIED.
A skipped required fixture is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
